name: Inverse Mean Residual Color (IMRC) Metric
definition: A metric to evaluate geometry quality by measuring the transmittance-density-weighted residual color in dB. Higher IMRC indicates better geometry.
summary: The Inverse Mean Residual Color metric evaluates radiance field geometry without ground-truth data by measuring transmittance-density-weighted residual color, assessing the entire density field rather than just an iso-surface.
